sloka: कुले जात महाप्राज्ञ महावृत्त महायश: ।ग्राह्यं रामस्य वाक्यं ते पितरं यद्यवेक्षसे ॥ २.११२.५॥
transliteration: kule jāta mahāprājña mahāvṛtta mahāyaśa: ।grāhyaṁ rāmasya vākyaṁ te pitaraṁ yadyavekṣase ॥ 2.112.5॥

translations.english: O Bharata, born in an illustrious race, highly sagacious and a man of virtuous conduct and great renown, accept Rama's proposal if you have any regard for your father.
